title: Procedural Three-Strand Cable
weighting_note: GEO 60 covers independent final form, scale, rounding, join continuity, and planar path outcomes. PROC 30 tests retained profile, twist/repetition, and curve relationships. PIPE 10 covers reproducible delivery. The source contains no substantive material design, rig, physical simulation, or timeline animation.

rubric.criterion: Three equal strands form a closely packed regular twisted bundle.

scoring_rule.PASS: Exactly three equally thick strands wind around a common centerline at a steady pitch, remaining closely bundled with narrow grooves and without large gaps or deep crossings.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: A recognizable twisted cable contains three distinguishable strands. Not all PASS conditions are met.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No recognizable twisted cable with three distinguishable strands is present.

verification.method: evaluated geometry inspection and functional probe
verification.procedure: Inspect neutral evaluated renders and cross-sections along the cable, including both bends; trace each strand and compare its thickness and relationship to its neighbors.

rubric.criterion: The unbent cable has the required total length and repeated winding scale.

scoring_rule.PASS: The unbent cable is 155-165 m long, has approximately one complete turn per 20 m section, and eight repeated full-turn sections with the reference long slender proportions.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: The unbent cable is long and contains multiple complete twist revolutions. Not all PASS conditions are met.
scoring_rule.FAIL: The unbent cable is absent, is not long, or lacks multiple complete twist revolutions.

verification.method: evaluated geometry inspection and functional probe
verification.procedure: Disable path deformation on a temporary copy, measure axial extent and strand-center winding along the evaluated geometry, and restore the submitted state.

rubric.criterion: The cords have smooth round cross-sections and stable thickness through bends.

scoring_rule.PASS: Each cord has a round cross-section and smooth silhouette throughout, without low-sided faceting, pinches, abrupt thickness changes, or shading discontinuities.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: The present strands have rounded rather than angular-prism surfaces. Not all PASS conditions are met.
scoring_rule.FAIL: The strands are absent or retain angular-prism rather than rounded surfaces.

verification.method: evaluated geometry inspection and functional probe
verification.procedure: Inspect isolated neutral-material renders and evaluated cross-sections at straight and bent regions under grazing illumination.

rubric.criterion: Repeated sections join into continuous strands without geometric or phase discontinuities.

scoring_rule.PASS: All internal strand joins are continuous, without gaps, steps, exposed internal caps, doubled seam rims, or twist-phase jumps; only the outer ends may be open.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: Repeated cable sections meet closely enough to form one visible cable. Not all PASS conditions are met.
scoring_rule.FAIL: Repeated sections do not meet closely enough to form one visible cable, or repeated sections are absent.

verification.method: evaluated geometry inspection and functional probe
verification.procedure: Inspect evaluated topology and close neutral renders at every section boundary with path deformation disabled, then confirm joins remain intact with the path enabled.

rubric.criterion: A single retained open-tube source drives all three generated cords.

scoring_rule.PASS: The retained single tube source non-destructively drives strand extension and three-strand placement; changing its profile size updates all generated cords consistently and leaves real evaluated geometry.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: An editable open tube source produces a visible change in generated cable geometry. Not all PASS conditions are met.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No editable open tube source produces a visible change in generated cable geometry.

verification.method: evaluated geometry inspection and functional probe
verification.procedure: Inspect the source-to-result dependency, temporarily adjust source profile size, and compare evaluated cord cross-sections along all three strands before restoring.

rubric.criterion: Twist and repetition controls change winding and length independently.

scoring_rule.PASS: Twist changes visibly alter winding; changing repetition from eight to four approximately halves unbent length while preserving local twist pitch and cord thickness, with nonempty evaluated geometry.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: At least one exposed twist or repetition control effectively changes evaluated cable geometry. Not all PASS conditions are met.
scoring_rule.FAIL: Neither an exposed twist control nor a repetition control effectively changes evaluated cable geometry.

verification.method: evaluated geometry inspection and functional probe
verification.procedure: On a copy with path bending disabled, vary twist, restore it, then change repetition from eight to four. Compare winding, axial extent, cord cross-sections, and evaluated geometry before restoring all controls.

rubric.criterion: The final cable follows a smooth planar S while retaining all three strands.

scoring_rule.PASS: The centerline forms a shallow planar S with opposite bend directions, smooth transitions, and no self-crossing or sharp kink; all three bundled strands follow the path.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: The cable has a curved centerline with two distinguishable bends. Not all PASS conditions are met.
scoring_rule.FAIL: The cable lacks a curved centerline with two distinguishable bends.

verification.method: evaluated geometry inspection and functional probe
verification.procedure: Inspect overhead and side evaluated views, trace centerline curvature through both bends, and inspect the bundle at the strongest curvature.

rubric.criterion: The path remains live and can be disabled to reveal the straight twisted generator output.

scoring_rule.PASS: Moving a middle control point within the plane updates the cable path; disabling path deformation reveals the full straight twisted cable, and restoring it returns the S-shaped result.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: An editable curve control changes the cable path. Not all PASS conditions are met.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No editable curve control changes the cable path.

verification.method: evaluated geometry inspection and functional probe
verification.procedure: On a temporary copy, move a middle curve control point in-plane, compare evaluated cable centerlines, then disable and restore path deformation and verify that the generated twist persists.

rubric.criterion: An editable project, reproducible build, and authentic complete-cable PNG are delivered.

scoring_rule.PASS: All three named files exist; the blend retains the requested live generator and path, build.py rebuilds them from the stated start, and the actual-scene PNG clearly shows the complete cable, both bends, and separate strands with neutral material and lighting using Blender 5.1.2 and Cycles GPU settings.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: A readable submission.blend contains the recognizable cable asset. Not all PASS conditions are met.
scoring_rule.FAIL: submission.blend is absent, unreadable, or lacks a recognizable cable asset.

verification.method: evaluated geometry inspection and functional probe
verification.procedure: Open the blend and inspect live assets/settings; run build.py in a clean Blender 5.1.2 process and compare the rebuilt scene and controlled render with the delivered blend and PNG. This future procedure was not executed during authoring.
